name: Liên Đoàn Kateri Tekakwitha
affiliation: Vietnamese Eucharistic Youth Movement in Canada
introduction: United in the Eucharist. Growing in faith, friendship, and service across our Vietnamese Catholic communities in Ontario.
about: The Vietnamese Eucharistic Youth Movement (VEYM), known as Thiếu Nhi Thánh Thể (TNTT), accompanies young people as they grow in friendship with Jesus. Prayer, the Eucharist, formation, and service bring our faith into everyday life.
history: A Liên Đoàn brings local chapters together for shared formation and fellowship. Established on July 14, 2019, Liên Đoàn Kateri Tekakwitha serves seven chapters across Ontario, within the Archdiocese of Toronto and the dioceses of Hamilton and London.
patronText: Under the patronage of Saint Kateri Tekakwitha, we journey together in faith and service.
contactText: Looking for a chapter, a formation opportunity, or a way to serve? We would be glad to hear from you.
leadershipIntro: Called to accompany our chapters and serve our young people in the spirit of Christ.
footer: Serving the Vietnamese Catholic youth of Ontario.
seoTitle: Liên Đoàn Kateri Tekakwitha | VEYM Ontario
seoDescription: Meet Liên Đoàn Kateri Tekakwitha, the VEYM league serving seven Vietnamese Catholic youth chapters in Ontario. Find announcements, chapters, leadership, and forms.
